title: Lakota cosmology of the Black Hills as a sky place

tellings.quote: In Lakota cosmology, the hills are specifically a sky place, a star map where ceremonial sights on the ground mirror the constellations above

plain: For the Lakota, a Native American people, the Black Hills of South Dakota are a sky place, a kind of star map where ceremonial sites on the ground mirror the constellations above. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens.
